title: kubecon-2026-travel-expenses-scratchpad
content:
KubeCon 2026 travel / expenses scratchpad - notes to self

Quick context:
- Attending KubeCon North America (Austin) — speaker slot on day 2 (avoid double-booking).
- Dates: conference 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12; plan travel 3/9 -> 3/13.
- Budget owner: Product Marketing (PMM) - code: KUBECON-2026 (double-check with Maya).

Flight info (booked on corporate AMEX - need receipt):
- Flight A: UA 438, SFO -> AUS, 2026-03-09, depart 07:05, arrive 13:12, PNR: HJ4K8P
- Return: UA 712, AUS -> SFO, 2026-03-13, depart 16:00, arrive 18:40
- Booking agent: Concur / AmTrav - expense record ID pending
- Action: upload e-ticket PDF to expense, tag with KUBECON-2026 and "travel/air"

Hotel (group rate; invoice to be sent to finance OR claim reimbursement):
- Hotel: Austin Convention Hotel (placeholder name) - reservation under "Redwood Inference"
- Confirmation #: 77421-RED
- Check-in: 2026-03-09; check-out: 2026-03-13
- Rate: $289/night (govt rate? negotiated) - ask Samir for the booking link
- Vendor contact: Front Desk +1 (512) 555-0199; Sales rep: Elena Martinez, elena.martinez@austconhotels.com
- Note: If hotel invoice doesn't include company billing, need to submit folio as receipt. Save folio at checkout.

Booth / sponsorship / exhibitor logistics (if applicable):
- Shipping vendor: FedEx / GES (confirm). Contact at GES: Alex Rivera, alex.rivera@ges.com, +1 (800) 555-2244
- Booth invoice estimate: $7,200 (includes carpet, electricity). Save invoices and upload as "vendor/booth" category.

Ground transport:
- Plan: rideshare to/from airport; keep receipts (email receipts OK).
- Rental car? Not needed; using rideshare + hotel shuttle. If rental booked, note insurance charge separately.

Expense submission checklist (what to include):
- Air e-ticket (PDF) + boarding passes (if asked)
- Hotel folio and payment proof (AMEX statement or hotel invoice)
- Meals: per diem? Finance uses actuals up to cap. Save itemized receipts for meals > $25.
- Local transport: rideshare receipts, taxi, mileage (if driving)
- Booth/vendor invoices (PDFs) + proof of payment
- Misc: printing, shipping, swag receipts

How to tag expenses in Concur/Expensify (notes):
- Project/Cost center: PMM - Redwood Product Marketing
- Expense code: KUBECON-2026
- Tax treatment: mark vendor invoices as "marketing/イベント" (confirm with finance)
- Attachments: upload PDFs, link to Confluence page with campaign plan

Reimbursement timing / deadlines:
- Submit within 30 days of travel end to avoid delay. Finance (FIN-1243) indicated monthly cutoff on the 25th.
- For sponsorship invoices, route to Accounting with "AP Invoice" workflow and cc: finance-ops@redwood.com

Receipts to collect (quick list):
- Air e-ticket (done)
- Boarding pass screenshots (collect after travel)
- Hotel folio (get at checkout)
- Meals: save all itemized receipts (credit card or paper)
- Taxi/rideshare: forward email receipts to expenses@redwood.com if possible
- Booth shipping: ask GES for itemized invoice and BOL (bill of lading)

Vendor contacts (dump - confirm before sharing externally):
- Hotel sales: Elena Martinez, elena.martinez@austconhotels.com, +1 (512) 555-0199
- GES (show services): Alex Rivera, alex.rivera@ges.com, +1 (800) 555-2244
- Catering (conference): Lisa Nguyen, lisa.nguyen@confcater.com, +1 (512) 555-3311
- Local AV: TechSound Inc, av-support@techsound.com, +1 (512) 555-4422

Speaker logistics / checklist:
- Confirm A/V needs with TechSound (wired laptop + HDMI adapter, clicker)
- Upload slides to speaker portal by 3/1/2026
- Print one-pager handout (2-sided) — coordinate with Solutions Eng for copy
- Bring backup laptop + dongles

Budget notes / things to confirm with Maya:
- Is booth cost on Redwood corporate card or to invoice? (Maya to confirm)
- Does PMM have leftover credits to cover hotel nights?
- Max meal per diem? Finance has $75/day cap in Austin (confirm with policy page linked above)

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm whether sponsor invoice should be submitted as AP invoice or expense (ask finance)
- [ ] Get hotel folio at checkout (reminder)
- [ ] Confirm booth shipping vendor and request itemized quote from GES
- [ ] Get final attendee list for badge registration (Maya)
- [ ] Register for speaker rehearsal slot (deadline 2026-02-25)

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep physical receipts in small envelope during trip. Take photos as backup.
- If any charge hits personal card, escalate to Samir for fast-track approval.
- If swapping flights, make sure to record change fee separately in Concur.

Past reference: see Confluence "Events / KubeCon 2025" for previous budgets and vendor notes (copy over any useful line items).

End of scratchpad — update as bookings/invoices come in.
